text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Injected transfers at 16 Primary substations, starting in October 2025 and February, April, and June 2026; shapes S2, S3, S4, and S6. Forecast origins inside the transfer, by time since it began. Error is measured against the true unmodified power. Dot: estimate, weighted by the MW moved. Line: 95% interval from re- drawing whole months. RO-NC: refit-offset neighbour-count detector, run only on data before the origin.'
text.tspan: Injected transfers at 16 Primary substations, starting in October 2025 and February, April,
and June 2026; shapes S2, S3, S4, and S6.
Forecast origins inside the transfer, by time since it began. Error is measured against the
true unmodified power. Dot: estimate, weighted by the MW moved. Line: 95% interval from re-
drawing whole months. RO-NC: refit-offset neighbour-count detector, run only on data before
